metadata.title: Vintage Soul Portrait with Organic Script

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, warm-toned 1970s film portrait featuring a central figure in a wide-brimmed hat with hand-drawn, organic green script in the upper corners.
triggerTerms: warm analog film look with wide brim hat
excludeWhen: modern high-definition digital photography is required
cool-toned or blue-heavy palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly low-angle portrait of a man with a mustache and afro, wearing a large black felt hat and a dark coat. The lighting is soft and warm, creating a nostalgic analog film grain. The background is a flat, off-white cream color, providing a neutral canvas for the dark silhouette of the subject and the vibrant green, organic-style lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark mass of the hat and coat frames the warm skin tones of the face.
The green script in the upper corners balances the heavy visual weight of the subject.
The cigarette provides a small, bright vertical anchor near the bottom center.
The off-white background creates a high-contrast silhouette for the dark clothing.
coreInvariants: Wide-brimmed black hat as a primary framing device

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and scaled to fill approximately 80% of the vertical frame, with the hat brim extending nearly to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the cigarette form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move up to the green script in the corners, and then down the line of the coat collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the upper corners and small gaps around the hat, colored in a warm cream.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the clothing and hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green for the typography; subtle red and white details in the collar and cigarette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and organic greens

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a brush or felt-tip marker
Interconnected lowercase letters with upright, slightly bouncy baseline
Distinctive 'j' and 'g' descenders with soft loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters are only slightly larger than lowercase
The dot on the 'i' is a soft, organic blob

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in negative space above the hat

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single organic script used for both artist name and title to maintain a cohesive, personal feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, marker-like quality of the original lettering.
Matches the era's preference for soft, rounded, hand-rendered forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, grainy 1970s film portrait of a man with an afro and mustache wearing a large black wide-brimmed felt hat and a dark coat against a cream background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, forest green organic script in the top left and top right corners using a fluid, marker-style stroke.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and authentic to the 70s?
Does the green script look hand-rendered rather than digitally typed?
Is the color palette warm and earth-toned?
Does the hat brim create a strong silhouette against the background?

mustRedesign: Do not use standard system fonts
Ensure the background is not a pure, sterile white
postGenerationChecks: Check for film-like grain consistency across the image.
Ensure the green text color feels integrated, not like a digital sticker.
Verify the subject's expression remains soulful and contemplative.
Confirm the composition maintains the heavy-top/bottom balance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a tight analog portrait with a wide-brimmed hat and organic, hand-drawn corner typography in a warm, earth-toned palette.
